about: Example two-letter source-project prefixes for word codes. Copy this file to ~/.config/word-codes/prefixes.json (or point WORD_CODES_PREFIXES at a copy) and list your own projects. Prefixes are assigned explicitly (never derived from the name) and unique. "xx" is reserved for a project not listed here. "aliases" maps other names a project goes by (repo folder, a project field in another tool) to its registered name.
